cctlive.attached: [cct-live] An AI has taken control of computer %s (lease %s s; /cctlive detach %s takes it back)
cctlive.expired: [cct-live] The AI's lease on computer %s expired; released
cctlive.removed: [cct-live] Computer %s was removed; the AI's control ended
cctlive.revoked: [cct-live] Took control of computer %s back from the AI
cctlive.list.none: [cct-live] No computer is controlled by an AI
cctlive.list.entry: [cct-live] Computer %s: controlled by an AI, lease ends in %s s
cctlive.detach.none: [cct-live] Computer %s is not controlled by an AI
cctlive.unavailable: [cct-live] Computer %s is no longer loaded or available; the AI control ended
cctlive.network.not_ready: [cct-live] Network bridge is not ready. Reconnect to the server.
cctlive.network.denied: [cct-live] Effective FTB block interaction AND block edit permission are required.
cctlive.network.limit: [cct-live] Too many grants. Revoke unused grants first.
cctlive.network.allowed: [cct-live] Your local AI is authorized for computer %s for 30 minutes. /cctlive network revoke %s revokes access.
cctlive.network.revoked: [cct-live] Revoked your local AI access to computer %s.
cctlive.network.none: [cct-live] No network grants. Authorize AI from its computer screen, or use /cctlive network authorize <ID> beside the computer.
cctlive.network.nearby: [cct-live] A unique, loaded, usable block computer must be nearby.
cctlive.network.icon.allow: Authorize the local AI for this computer (30 minutes)
cctlive.network.icon.authorized: Local AI authorized, about %s min left. Click to revoke
cctlive.network.icon.unsupported: Pocket computers cannot be authorized over the network yet
cctlive.network.unsupported: [cct-live] Pocket computers cannot be authorized over the network yet; only block computers and turtles can.
cctlive.network.revoke_command: [cct-live] Cannot identify this computer; use /cctlive network revoke <ID>.
